meta.themes: Coding Agents, Federal Sales, Copyright Pressure, Inference Economics

news.title: OpenAI launched GPT-5.4 mini and nano for coding, subagents, and lower-cost inference
news.summary: OpenAI introduced smaller GPT-5.4 variants aimed at fast tool use and subagent workflows, broadening the model stack beyond the flagship release from early March.

news.title: OpenAI signed a deal to sell AI access to U.S. agencies through AWS
news.summary: Reuters reported OpenAI would distribute models to defense and government customers through Amazon's cloud unit, extending its public-sector reach.

news.title: OpenAI explored a private-equity-backed enterprise AI venture
news.summary: Reuters said OpenAI was in talks with major private-equity firms to fund a new enterprise venture, highlighting how capital formation is moving downstream from model training into go-to-market.

news.title: Nvidia raised its inference opportunity forecast to $1 trillion
news.summary: Reuters reported Jensen Huang used GTC to frame inference, not just training, as the next major revenue engine for AI infrastructure.

news.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica sued OpenAI over AI training on reference content
news.summary: Reuters reported another high-profile copyright case against OpenAI, increasing pressure on model developers to defend training-data practices in court.

news.title: Microsoft unified its commercial and consumer Copilot teams
news.summary: Reuters reported Microsoft reorganized Copilot under a single product structure, signaling tighter integration between enterprise and consumer AI bets.

news.title: Pressure mounted inside the Pentagon to move off Anthropic's Claude
news.summary: Reuters reported defense officials were struggling to unwind entrenched Claude usage even as top-level pressure grew to remove Anthropic from sensitive workflows.

news.title: GitHub added secret scanning to AI coding agents through the GitHub MCP Server
news.summary: GitHub said coding agents can now scan code changes for exposed secrets before commit or pull request creation, directly through MCP-backed workflows.

news.title: GitHub gave Copilot coding agent semantic code search
news.summary: GitHub said coding agent can now find relevant code by meaning instead of just exact text matches, improving task startup quality on larger repos.

news.title: GitHub exposed configurable validation tools for Copilot coding agent
news.summary: GitHub let teams control which tests, linters, and validation tools agent runs before proposing changes, making agent output easier to operationalize in existing CI flows.

news.title: GitHub rolled GPT-5.4 mini into Copilot
news.summary: GitHub announced general availability of GPT-5.4 mini in Copilot, giving developers faster access to OpenAI's newest lightweight coding model inside GitHub workflows.

news.title: VS Code 1.112 added switchable plugins and MCP servers without uninstalling them
news.summary: Visual Studio Code introduced finer control over plugins and MCP servers, making it easier to manage agent tooling across different projects and contexts.
